# ImageHeight <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Images](BlitzBasic-Images)

```blitzbasic
ImageHeight:Int32 image:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | In | Int32 | required | The image. |

**Returns:** The height of a frame.

## Description

The height of one frame of an image in pixels.
